Whereas you have been found duly qualified and competent to fulfill the duties of Chief 
Engineer Officer on vessels of unlimited power operating in international waters, the 
International Maritime Training Academy, in exercise of their powers under the International 
Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping for Seafarers (STCW),
 hereby grants you this International Certificate of Competency.

This certificate authorizes the holder to serve as Chief Engineer Officer on merchant 
vessels registered under participating flag states and operating in all waters worldwide.

Recognized under STCW Convention 1978, as amended. 
Registered at the International Maritime Certification Registry | Registry Number: IMTA-COC-2026-156742
